reviews.text: We received a very warm welcome and attentive care for our cat :)

Our cat Nala has been seeing Dr. Ehrlich since we adopted her. His gentleness, attentiveness, and the quality of care he provides during consultations are truly exceptional. If you're looking for a professional who is kind to your pet and takes the time to truly care for them, this is the place to go!
THANKS !
Dr. Ehrlich and her wonderful assistant are truly exceptional. I never could have imagined how much Dr. Ehrlich invested in and cared for my cat. I am so grateful that this practice exists.

It's always a very pleasant experience taking our cat to see Dr. Maya Ehrlich. We were impressed by her professionalism, her very human touch, and her deep empathy for animals. We have complete confidence in her abilities and recommend her without hesitation!

Another visit to our wonderful vet before heading off on vacation; she examined our two cats carefully! We're leaving completely reassured, everything is fine! Maxou and Luppo are in great shape! Maya has resolved a few minor health issues, which is fantastic!
Excellent veterinary practice, my two cats have been treated here for 5 years, nothing to complain about 👍🏽 …

Fantastic vet, so attentive and patient!

I discovered her by chance when my kitten, who's been suffering from cat flu ever since I got him, started seeing her. She tailors the treatment to what's possible and what you want.

After consulting several other clinics in the neighborhood that were much less good, I'm absolutely thrilled with this vet!

I highly recommend this vet! Everything went perfectly during my first visit after moving to Paris. She was lovely, very attentive, and gave me invaluable advice as well as all the useful numbers to help me settle in with my cat.

Special mention for her gentle and reassuring approach: my cat has never been so calm and relaxed at the vet's, which is truly rare!

A huge thank you for your professionalism and kindness 🐾
I've been taking my cat there for 10 years, and they always provide attentive care, smiles, and kindness. In short, I can only recommend this clinic!

The best vet in Paris. Passionate and dedicated to her work, we've been seeing her for our cat for 5 years. Always very attentive, excellent rapport with our cat, and very good advice. I highly recommend her.

An excellent veterinarian, professional, attentive, and very kind. She has been treating my cat for 5 years with great gentleness and dedication. I recommend her without hesitation for the quality of care and the consistently warm welcome.
Excellent veterinarian who listens to both owners and animals.
Superb, caring, and professional vet!! Our cats adore her

Dr Ehrlich is one of the best veterinarians I have met. I relocated to Paris from Singapore with dog, Snoopy, and I am glad I found her. She is extremely knowledgeable with regard to  the regulations both in France and in foreign countries for bringing dogs across borders. She even corrected me on the tests required to bring Snoopy back into Singapore! This is testament to her attention to detail and her breadth of experience. Above all, she is kind and caring with my dog, she is always thorough and gentle with her medical examinations, and I can truly see that she loves animals and has their best interests at heart. If you are an expat in Paris looking for an English-speaking vet, I should also add that Dr Ehrlich speaks perfect English. Thank you Dr Ehrlich and the rest of the lovely team!
Dr. Ehlich is a truly caring professional who always takes the time to answer all my questions and concerns in detail. Even my cat, who is usually so timid, seems to feel comfortable with her.
Dr. Ehrlich always takes the time to answer all questions kindly!
My cat has been under Dr. Ehrlich's care for a year now. I'm very happy with him, and so is my cat! My cat had feline herpesvirus (FHV-1), and the treatment was excellent and quick.
I recommend this veterinarian; he takes the time to answer all our questions. Always in a good mood and a very competent assistant.
I highly recommend the Ehrlich Veterinary Clinic. Living in the neighborhood, I take my four-legged companion there with complete confidence.

Dr. Ehrlich and his assistant are attentive and caring.

It's a small practice where it's easy to make an appointment. Animals are very well received and treated gently.

I've been going there for over two years for my cat's neutering and vaccinations. If a more serious problem arises that can't be handled at the practice, Dr. Ehrlich knows how to refer you to other specialists to care for your little companions. Thank you!
Dr. Ehrlich is extremely professional, attentive, and gentle. It was very easy for us to make an appointment, and we are happy and reassured to have her for our cat's care. I highly recommend her.
Fantastic vet! Very professional, kind, and attentive. Our kitten received excellent care. I highly recommend her!
Dr. Ehrlich truly loves animals, and it shows in his approach to care. He always gives sound advice, is always pleasant, and takes remarkable care of our pets. I highly recommend this veterinarian.
Excellent practice. Dr. Ehrlich and his assistant are very attentive and professional. My little Mei was the last patient to be vaccinated. Thank you.
I received a very warm welcome, the vet was very dynamic and took excellent care of the animals, I highly recommend them 👌🏻 …

My cat was neutered at this clinic and everything went extremely well. The operation was a complete success: he was already in great shape the very next day, and today the scar is barely visible.

Dr. Ehrlich is very professional, gentle, and above all, very patient. She took the time to answer all my questions before and after the procedure, which was very reassuring.

I highly recommend this clinic. A huge thank you for your professionalism and your kindness towards animals!
Very happy with this firm for many years. Competent and friendly.
We trust Dr. Ehrlich to take care of our little cat. She demonstrates great expertise as well as a great passion for animals, and we are very grateful for her help!

Dr. Ehrlich is not only an extremely competent veterinarian, but also a wonderful person with invaluable kindness. When we brought our cat in, who was scheduled to be euthanized within two hours (a diagnosis given by another clinic), Dr. Ehrlich saw hope and saved our cat. For that, I am eternally grateful. This veterinarian always sees the positive and always tries to find a solution without having to spend money on unnecessary operations. In short, I HIGHLY recommend her!

Dr. Erlich is the best vet!

She has been treating our cat (12 years old) and our dog (6 years old) since they were puppies, and thanks to her experience, constant attention, and professionalism, our pets are extremely well cared for and in top condition. 100% confidence rating 👍👍👍
A very professional and gentle veterinarian with animals.

A very reputable clinic. We were greeted by a very empathetic doctor who clearly explained our cat's problem. The doctor took all the time necessary to reassure us. We highly recommend this clinic. Thank you.
Ms. Ehrlich is available and attentive. She makes accurate diagnoses, gives good advice and above all, takes the time to examine and discuss the life of the animal in her care.

Dr. Ehrlich is a very friendly professional. She is truly passionate about her work. She has a deep love for animals, and it shows in every consultation. She always takes the time to listen and advise us with kindness. Our cat Pepper, as a veterinary expert, highly recommends her!

Top-notch caregiving duo! Smiles and a passion for our animal friends.
I highly recommend them.

Excellent veterinary practice in every way! Competence, kindness, rapport with animals (and humans!), prices, advice, and availability from both the veterinarian and her assistant. I've been going there for three years for our cats, and the service is always top-notch!

They are incredible veterinarians who take great care of the animals entrusted to them.

They always give good advice and are incredibly caring and available.

Very pleasant welcome.
Very attentive.

Excellent vet and assistant.
They always have a smile and are always attentive to the animals and their owners.

Excellent service, the veterinarian and assistant were professional, caring, and attentive. Ms. Ehrich took the time to reassure my extremely stressed cat; she is very gentle and caring. Impeccable follow-up care; I highly recommend her!
We take great care of our animals

Oreo loves putting his paws there! Great vet. Very professional and attentive.
Thank you so much for your hospitality!

I've been going to this clinic since 2018 and I'm always very satisfied. The team is professional, caring, and attentive, whether it's for a routine check-up or an emergency. You can tell they genuinely love animals and they take the time to explain treatments. I've trusted them completely all these years!

Excellent vet, very gentle and attentive. My 16-year-old cat, who isn't used to being treated, felt comfortable right away.

She takes the time to explain and reassure, and you can tell she has a deep love for animals.
A passionate professional, I recommend her without hesitation. 🐾

A very friendly and understanding veterinarian who explains everything your pet might be experiencing from A to Z, offering excellent advice and a cheerful attitude. Our cat is starting to recover little by little despite his kidney problems!

I highly recommend her.
Super !
Thank you so much for your feedback!
A lovely vet, attentive and very reassuring. You can tell she's truly dedicated. I highly recommend her.

Dr. Maya Ehlich saved my elderly cat from painful and costly overmedication by conducting a thorough medical investigation and refuting, with compelling evidence, a diagnosis of kidney failure made by a major clinic. I am deeply grateful to her for giving my cat several years of peace of mind thanks to her vigilant expertise.

As always, a top-notch welcome from a veterinarian who truly cares about our animals' well-being and who adapted the treatment to our living conditions (including our outdoor stay). All this with a smile and the perfect amount of explanation! Thank you so much, and see you in six months for the other cat.
Dr. Ehrlich is a competent and highly professional veterinarian. She is also gentle and caring. Wafaâ Chaouki
Great! Thanks for everything

A gentle, competent, and incredibly kind vet ⭐️ We took in a kitten, not really knowing much about animals and a bit stressed about doing something wrong. We were lucky enough to meet Dr. Ehrlich. She's very compassionate, takes the time to explain everything to us, reassures us, and is always smiling and attentive. We couldn't have dreamed of a better vet for our kitten's crucial first checkups. It's clear she loves her job! Thanks also to her assistant; they work together perfectly, and you can leave your pets in good hands! 🙌

I'm Spanish and I don't speak French, but my husband does. After a very disappointing experience at another clinic that turned us away because of the language barrier, we discovered this veterinarian almost by chance, and it was a real stroke of luck. She saw us the same day, without an appointment, and was remarkably accommodating.

From the moment we arrived, she greeted us with a warm smile and exceptional kindness. You can immediately feel her passion for animals and the great respect she has for each of her patients. Our cat, Luna, remained calm thanks to the gentleness, delicacy, and affection the veterinarian showed.

Although I don't speak French, she did everything she could to make sure I understood every explanation, using gestures, smiles, and even English so that nothing was missed. This attention to making us feel comfortable and understood was truly invaluable.

I recommend this clinic 100%: professionalism, empathy, love for animals, and a simply exemplary level of hospitality. A true model of what a veterinary service should be.

A first for me, having moved. A one-hour wait, which seems exceptional, but I was warned it was a last-minute appointment, and given the time she dedicates to each patient, I understand. I felt like I was at my old-fashioned general practitioner's office. It's far from being about numbers and a parade of patients. Dr. Ehrlich takes her time, listens, gives good advice, and it's clear she loves animals. We'll see how it goes with my cat, but it was truly an excellent experience. One small detail: the clinic closes at 7:30 pm, and I was seen at 7:40 pm, which was quite an achievement considering there was still someone waiting after me.
You can tell she's passionate and doesn't watch the clock. That's still my first impression, but go without hesitation.
A very professional and attentive veterinarian, kind and caring towards animals. She doesn't hesitate to call you to discuss the results obtained from a hospital.

An extremely professional and friendly veterinarian with sound advice. The consultation fee is reasonable. I used to go to this vet for my dog ​​Hyllo. I now go without hesitation for my cat Roquette. The availability and kindness of the veterinary assistant should also be noted. Thank you!

A top-notch vet!
Professional, gentle, patient, and truly attentive, you can tell she loves animals and is a true expert in her field! She takes the time to explain, reassure, and always gives excellent advice.
I highly recommend her!
An amazing vet! Highly competent, she's been looking after my cats for 10 years 😇 …
A welcoming, efficient, and attentive team; highly recommended.
My dog ​​was so happy to come! Direct trust and kindness are rare. Thank you for the care.
Very attentive to animals, passionate and knowledgeable about her subjects!!

A perfect vet!
Very attentive and friendly, professional, knows her stuff, and answers all your questions perfectly, offering great advice! Very gentle with your animals, even the most difficult ones, like my little terror!
The veterinary assistant is lovely! The clinic is very well-maintained and the prices are reasonable!

Hello, I received excellent service for my vaccination booster appointment. I was given very clear and precise information regarding booster shots and the rabies vaccination. I also received recommendations concerning the diet of my White Swiss Shepherd. I therefore highly recommend this practice.

Our cat has been seen by Dr. Ehrlich since we adopted her, and we are delighted! She is always attentive and takes the time to give us the best advice. Her examinations are meticulous and thorough. The follow-up care is excellent; she keeps a file with all the important information.
The vet is super kind and gentle. My slightly stressed cat immediately felt at ease. I highly recommend her!

Dr. Ehrlich has been treating my cats for years. Very professional and attentive to the needs of each of my cats, she has always done her utmost for their well-being.

Moreover, there's always a cheerful atmosphere at the clinic, which is always a pleasure! :-)

Dr. Ehrlich has been taking care of my little Trésor since she was two months old. Very gentle and professional, she gives excellent advice, and her assistant is very friendly. A wonderful team. Thanks to them, Trésor is in excellent health. I highly recommend her.
Friendly team. Good advice for our cat Touki's trip, all the formalities were completed correctly, the trip went very well.

My cat has been seeing Dr. Ehrlich for three years now. I'm delighted; she's very professional, very pleasant, gentle yet firm with animals. She listens attentively and knows the animals she treats very well. I recommend her 100%.
Excellent veterinarian. Dr. Ehrlich is kind and gentle with our cat, who is very stressed by vet visits. We have complete confidence in her!
Great welcome, my dog ​​always gets his little reward and above all: great vet.
Very satisfied with the surgery on my cat who recovered very well and is in great shape, thank you

My ginger cat Oscar has been a patient of Dr. Erlich since his adoption. He isn't terrified during examinations, and his minor ear problems were quickly resolved. When my cat Gepetto passed away, Dr. Erlich and his charming assistant showed great empathy, which I appreciated. I highly recommend this practice, where the reception is always very friendly.
The vet was incredibly kind and available; I received lots of valuable advice for my cat. I highly recommend her!
Fantastic vet! So lovely with our kittens!
Excellent welcome, professionalism and teaching methods greatly appreciated! Thank you!

Excellent service.
She took plenty of time to examine my cat and explain what was wrong with him.
She answered all my questions.
She didn't try to upsell me.
I highly recommend this veterinarian.
Thank you Ms. Patout for your review, it's always a pleasure to have you!

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic! Dr. Ehrlich and her colleague are extremely professional, always very welcoming and attentive. You can tell they truly love animals and take the time to care for them properly. My cat is always well looked after there, with gentleness and care. Thank you for your kindness and dedication!
Thank you very much, Ms. Turpin!
My diabetic cat is treated at this clinic and I highly recommend it: a very professional vet, always gives good advice and is very kind!
Excellent veterinarian who takes her time and gives very good advice

Thank you to Dr. Ehrlich and his assistant, who were always available and offered excellent advice on how to care for my cat.
Highly recommended!

I’m truly grateful for the exceptional care my cat has received from Dr. Ehrlich. She is not only kind and understanding, but also consistently patient and attentive during every visit. Her gentle approach immediately puts both me and my cat at ease, and her insightful advice has always been incredibly helpful. It’s clear that she genuinely cares about her patients and takes the time to explain everything thoroughly. I feel very fortunate to have found such a compassionate and knowledgeable veterinarian. Highly recommended!!
Seven years of attentive care and rigorous follow-up by Dr. Ehrlich and his assistant, and the welcome is always so pleasant and cheerful. A highly recommended practice!

We have been consulting Dr. Ehrlichl's veterinary practice for several years and recommend it without hesitation: Professional, attentive, and available. His explanations are clear and the welcome is warm!

Maya Erlich is very pleasant to work with. She has been taking care of our Cocker Spaniel for 8 years and has always been professional, readily referring us to colleagues for specific needs. We recommend her 100%.
I moved 5 years ago and I miss the BEST vet.

We went to see Dr. Ehrlich because she was close to our home, so it was a bit of a coincidence. She turned out to be very competent and, along with her assistant, took excellent care of our kitten. She gave us very good advice on all matters and provided us with lots of helpful tips. I highly recommend her.

I was very satisfied with my appointment with Dr. Ehrlich for my little cat who had an infection. She was very gentle, attentive, and caring. She also gave me advice on other things. I highly recommend her. 😺 Jennifer …
Excellent veterinary practice. The vet is both pleasant and truly professional, and loves and knows animals. I'm very happy with the care my cats and dog receive.
An excellent, competent, and very compassionate veterinarian. She works with an equally efficient assistant. Dr. Ehrlich has been caring for our cats for years. I highly recommend this practice.
A very friendly and competent team. We trust our vet completely!
Excellent veterinarian, attentive, professional and caring!
Super friendly vet… highly recommended 👍🏻🐾🐾🐾🐾 …

Dr. Ehrlich is an excellent veterinarian; she is very professional and knowledgeable. My cat has been receiving excellent care at her clinic for the past five years. Her assistant is also kind, competent, and efficient. They are always very gentle with the animals and have given me a lot of helpful advice. Thank you so much! I highly recommend this clinic; you can entrust your pets to them with complete confidence.

Ms. CAI

A huge thank you to the whole team. Dr. Ehrlich has always been a great help to our cat; she's an animal lover, respectful, professional, and also takes good care of the owners. I highly recommend her.

An independent veterinary practice, therefore not governed by the dictates of mutual insurance groups! Ms. Ehrlich is passionate and dedicated (even if she does talk a lot and loudly 😉). Attentive and professional, my cats have always felt at ease during our consultations! Go there without hesitation, your animals are in good hands! …
